entries.what: Across 56 healthy cell types the held error rises in one straight line with the loose share: firm end 0.0212, loose end 0.0497, r 0.87, 53 of 56 cells within 0.003, the same loose level for every cell class. Made reproducible: scripts, manifest rows (PHY-045, PHY-046), four-domain table.
